input.quote: Vendor may audit Customer's compliance with licence quantities no more than once in any twelve-month period, on at least thirty days' prior written notice, during normal business hours, and in a manner that does not unreasonably disrupt Customer. An audit will be conducted off-site where practicable by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality.
input.rationale: Section 22 is the only provision giving Vendor audit/verification rights over Customer (Section 23 "Records and Customer Assurance" contains no operative text, and no monitoring or inspection rights appear elsewhere). It meets the preferred position on every material term: frequency limited to once per twelve months; thirty days' prior written notice; normal business hours with no unreasonable disruption; off-site where practicable via an independent auditor bound by confidentiality; Vendor bears cost unless underpayment exceeds five percent; and Vendor and its auditor are expressly barred from direct access to Customer systems, unrelated Customer Data, privileged material, and third-party confidential information. Section 22.3 adds customer-favourable protections (findings are Customer Confidential Information, copy of the final report, finality on payment). No redline needed.
